title: Evaluation-defined internal Hom comparison under coefficient base change
statement: Let $A,B$ be categories, with internal-Hom bifunctors $H_A:A^{\mathrm{op}}\times A\to A$ and $H_B:B^{\mathrm{op}}\times B\to B$, equipped with closed tensor-Hom structures $S_A,S_B$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Let $F:A\to B$ be a functor and $\mu:F(X\otimes_A Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}FX\otimes_B FY$ a natural tensor comparison. For $P,Q\in A$, define the coefficient base-change map $c^F_{P,Q}:F(H_A(P,Q))\to H_B(FP,FQ)$ as the closed transpose, with respect to $S_B$, of $$F(H_A(P,Q))\otimes_B FP\xrightarrow{\mu^{-1}_{H_A(P,Q),P}}F(H_A(P,Q)\otimes_A P)\xrightarrow{F(\mathrm{ev}_{P,Q})}FQ.$$ The tensor, evaluation and transposition are those of the supplied closed structures. This definition imposes no invertibility assumption on $c^F_{P,Q}$.
